# Third-party notices

Free PDF SDK is built on [pdfcraft](https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft) by the ArtCraft Team
and the PdfCraft contributors (MIT OR Apache-2.0), at upstream commit `0dc77fe4ed8810b9e9f25b9dd050afae662c062a`.
Free PDF SDK modifies pdfcraft's interface crate (pdfcraft-ui-egui) with opt-in hooks for
white-label branding and for hiding features; the modified build is `9109e4f0c4ddc30e4c130180138aee28756f8201`
(`pdfcraftRev` in `version.json`). The viewer's .wasm embeds the material below; each
licence is in this folder. Generated by `scripts/collect-notices.mjs` — do not edit by hand.
